entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
By the oath of the fig and the olive.
And by this secure city (i.e. Makkah).
We have indeed created man in the best form.
We then turned him towards the lowest of the low state (i.e. old age).
Except those who believed and did good deeds, that for them is limitless reward.
Now (after all these proofs), what causes you to belie the Judgement (Day)?
Is Allah not the Greatest Ruler of all rulers?
